messages:
alex: Heads-up — starting Nomad8B bring-up. Early microbench + evals for int4 vs int6 vs fp16. sharing top-level numbers, need quick econ + routing recs. (3134000000)
maria: thanks. drop the numbers pls and the eval slices you ran.
alex: throughput (seq_len=256): fp16 110 tok/s, int6 135 tok/s (+23%), int4 160 tok/s (+45%). cost-per-1k-tokens rough: fp16=$0.045, int6=$0.028, int4=$0.020. (includes quantized runtime + infra amort)
jon: those cost deltas look promising. what's quality delta on convo QA and hallucination?
alex: convo QA (GTN-slice): fp16 baseline accuracy 0.92, int6 0.905 (-1.6ppt), int4 0.875 (-4.7ppt). hallucination rate (synthetic probe): fp16 3.5%, int6 4.1%, int4 6.8%.
emily: int4 loss of ~5ppt on accuracy is nontrivial. what's token-level calibration / confidence delta? any predictive signal we can route on?
alex: confidence shift: avg top-logit gap decreases ~12% int6, ~28% int4. calibration curve shows more overconfidence in int4 for long contexts >512. sample code we use to tag requests:
```
// simple routing signal
if (top_logit_gap < 0.8) route = fp16
else if (latency_sensitive) route = int4
else route = int6
```
raj: product asks for guidance: recommend a default for new consumer chat. my vote: int6 default, int4 for low-cost experiments behind a feature flag, fp16 for safety-critical paths.
maria: +1. also suggest hybrid: sampled 10% of int4 responses shadowed to int6/fp16 to compute rolling delta and auto-rollback if drift > threshold.
jon: can we quantify unit-econ impact per 100M tokens? quick calc: baseline fp16 cost = $4.5k, int6 = $2.8k, int4 = $2.0k. Savings from int6 vs fp16 = $1.7k / 100M tokens (~38%). int4 saves $2.5k (~56%). but quality cost: estimate product cost of 1ppt accuracy = $X — need product input.
emily: product input: for GTN, 1ppt QA drop increases escalations by ~0.2% of sessions historically. translate to ops cost: rough $300 per month per 100k sessions. do the math vs raw infra.
alex: quick roll plan proposal:
- canary 1: 1% traffic int6 (week), shadow int4 on 2% sample
- canary 2: 10% traffic int6, 5% int4 shadow + fidelity checks
- full: int6 default, int4 opt-in or best-effort tier
ops-bot: deploy started: infra/job/nomad8b-int6-canary-1 @ 3134000300 :rocket:
raj: monitoring — dashboards to add: per-route QA accuracy, hallucination probe failures, top-logit-gap distribution, latency p95, cost per token. alert if accuracy delta >1.5ppt for 24h or hallucination +2ppt.
maria: what about priming sensitivity? int4 seemed slightly worse when we primed with long system prompts (policy text). we should include longcontext slice (>1024) in canary.
alex: noted — added longcontext smoke. also saw KV-cache coldstart penalty ~+8ms for int4 in our runtime due to kernel path.
jon: any quantization-specific fixes to try before locking in int4? e.g., mixed-precision attention, per-channel scales?
alex: we tried per-channel symmetric scales and a tiny smearing for norm layers — improved int4 QA by ~0.6ppt but cost same. could be worth exploring but still not closing gap.
emily: product ask: give a one-liner recommendation for docs/console.
alex: recommended one-liner: "Use Nomad8B-int6 as the default cost-quality sweet spot; enable int4 for experimental/low-cost tiers with shadowing and automatic fidelity rollback; reserve fp16 for safety/priority routes." 
maria: add ops checklist to onboarding doc: baseline fp16 metrics, int6 cross-check, int4 guardrail thresholds, canary percentages, and retention window for shadow analyses.
jon: can someone drop a short scorecard snapshot for the GTN slices? one line each: accuracy, hallucination, latency, cost.
alex: pasted quick scorecard:
- fp16: acc=0.92 | hall=3.5% | p95=210ms | cost/1k=$0.045
- int6: acc=0.905 | hall=4.1% | p95=185ms | cost/1k=$0.028
- int4: acc=0.875 | hall=6.8% | p95=160ms | cost/1k=$0.020
emily: perfect. i'll put this into the GTN playbook and notify product.
raj: ok let's move forward with canary 1 tomorrow. ops-bot will post updates. thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: canary health check scheduled @3134001200 — will post status
